definition.en: The flat triangular bone at the back of the shoulder. It glides over the ribs and carries the socket of the shoulder joint.
definition.zh: 肩后面那块扁平的三角形骨。它贴着肋骨滑动，外侧有肩关节的关节盂。

definition.en: The end of a muscle that usually stays still when it contracts.
definition.zh: 肌肉收缩时通常不动的那一端。

definition.en: The end of a muscle that it pulls toward the origin when it contracts.
definition.zh: 肌肉收缩时被拉向起点的那一端。

definition.en: Tough sheets of connective tissue over the back of the trunk, from the ribs to the pelvis; latissimus dorsi starts on them.
definition.zh: 覆盖躯干背面、从肋骨一直到骨盆的强韧结缔组织膜；背阔肌就起于这里。

definition.en: A tough cord or sheet that joins a muscle to a bone and carries its pull.
definition.zh: 把肌肉连到骨头上、传递拉力的强韧条索或薄片。

definition.en: Drawing the shoulder blade back toward the spine.
definition.zh: 把肩胛骨往后拉向脊柱。

definition.en: Four muscles, supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis, whose tendons wrap the shoulder joint and hold the head of the humerus in its socket.
definition.zh: 冈上肌、冈下肌、小圆肌和肩胛下肌四块肌肉。它们的腱包住肩关节，把肱骨头稳在关节盂里。

definition.en: Turning the upper arm outward about its own long axis.
definition.zh: 上臂绕着自己的长轴向外转。

definition.en: Turning the shoulder blade so that its socket faces up, which lets the arm rise overhead.
definition.zh: 把肩胛骨转一下，让关节盂朝上，手臂才能举过头顶。

definition.en: Straightening a joint or moving it backward: at the shoulder the arm moves back, at the spine the trunk straightens or bends back.
definition.zh: 把关节伸直或往后动：肩关节伸是手臂往后，脊柱伸是躯干伸直或往后仰。

definition.en: Holding the back in its natural curves, neither rounded forward nor arched back.
definition.zh: 让背保持自然的弧度，既不往前弓，也不往后挺。

definition.en: A contraction in which the muscle works hard but stays the same length, so the joint does not move.
definition.zh: 肌肉用力但长度不变的收缩，所以关节不动。

definition.en: Electromyography: recording the electrical activity of a muscle. Higher EMG does not by itself mean more strength or growth.
definition.zh: 肌电图：记录肌肉的电活动。肌电高本身不等于更有力或长得更多。

definition.en: The part of a movement in which a working muscle lengthens under load, such as lowering a weight under control.
definition.zh: 动作中正在用力的肌肉在负荷下被拉长的阶段，例如有控制地放下重量。
